events: D4 16:57: Dal rings once and enters Maya kitchen. Tea jar and apples are on the table; a chair is ready.

Maya opens fresh one-use control: start, manual restoration and utility state. No history, profile or mediation text is exposed. Restoration targets the morning strengthened mode; automatic limit is 120 seconds.
Maya own return button lights up. She gives fresh confirmation after the clock changes to 17:00. Dal starts: utility active, emotional mediation off, no graph. His finger remains on manual backup.
Maya asks one question: what will he do with her silence if she explains nothing. Dal answers Nothing.
Neither asks another question. She looks at him; he waits for continuation and notices background sounds as a possible refuge.
He feels the urge to look at the state display but chooses not to. He does not interpret her expression as fear, trust or consent.
He lets his own face remain visible and stays in the gaze without a metric or explanation. R1 is an architectural assessment, not an onscreen rank.
Maya releases her fingers, then says Stop before the 120-second automatic end. Dal immediately presses manual restoration.
The strengthened mode returns, utilities remain active and one-use control closes. Maya reads private undisclosed text and confirms restoration.
She notes that he did not look at the device. She gives no meaning, reward or new consent. He still waits for an interpretation, but she does not supply one.
Dal packs the device; Maya ends the visit. He leaves the chair out; she points it out at the door. He returns to push it under the table, then leaves.
